title.narrative: Infrastructure Equity Fund Programme - Development Capital Investment (DCI)

description.narrative: This activity Infrastructure Equity Fund Programme - Development Capital Investment (DCI) is a component of India: Infrastructure Equity Fund - Investment in small infrastructure projects in India's poorest states reported by FCDO with a funding type of 113 - Other and a budget of £36,894,615. It works in the following sector(s): Environmental policy and administrative management, Small and medium-sized enterprises (SME) development.
